Initially, services will cover 3 products, as per the attached price sheets. However, this may be extended.
findings.explanation: The agreement allows for the scope of services to be extended without a formal change-order mechanism, creating a risk that extra work could be required without agreed pricing.
findings.suggested_change: Initially, services will cover 3 products, as per the attached price sheets. Any extension of services must be agreed upon in writing via a change order detailing the additional fees and terms.

findings.quoted_text: Dragon may terminate this agreement without cause by giving sixty (60) days written notice to [PARTY_B].
findings.explanation: Only the client can terminate the contract without cause, leaving you bound to the agreement unless a breach occurs.
findings.suggested_change: Either party may terminate this agreement without cause by giving sixty (60) days written notice to the other party.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I am writing to propose a minor adjustment before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause, the agreement allows for the scope of services to be extended without a formal change-order mechanism, so I propose modifying it to state that any extension of services must be agreed upon in writing via a change order detailing the additional fees and terms. Thank you for your time.
